name: Marmalade
description: Bitter-orange jam with the peel left in.

tcm.note: Citrus base with sugar; peel is warmer than flesh.

ayurveda.note: Sour, bitter and boiled with sugar — ushna.

histamine.note: Citrus with the peel, concentrated by boiling.

guna.note: Fresh and simple — the sattvic default for plant food eaten close to how it grew.
